           LEMNA MINOR

         Duckweed


A catarrhal remedy. Acts especially upon the nostrils.   Nasal polypi; swollen turbinates. Atrophic rhinitis  . Asthma
        from nasal obstruction; worse in wet weather.



Nose.--    Putrid smell  ; loss
        of smell. Crusts and muco-purulent discharge very abundant. Post-nasal dropping. Pain like a
        string from nostrils to ear. Reduces nasal obstruction when it is an œdematous condition.
        Dryness of naso-pharynx.



Mouth.--    Putrid taste   on
        rising in the morning. Dry pharynx and larynx.



Abdomen.--  Disposition to noisy diarrhœa.



Modalities.--    Worse  , in
        damp, rainy weather, especially   heavy rains  .



Relationship.--  Compare:   Dulc
        (damp surroundings and foggy weather).   Calc; Teucr; Calend; Nat
        sulph  .



Dose.--  Third to thirtieth potency.
